# Black Bean Chili

> [!note] Web clip waiting for review
> Open Recipe Manager to review this clip. It is not a finished recipe, and it is not offered for shopping lists, until you save the review.

Clipped from https://www.example-kitchen.test/recipes/black-bean-chili

## Ingredients

- 2 Tbsp. olive oil
- 1 large onion, diced
- 3-4 cloves garlic, minced
- 1 ½ cups dried black beans
- 400 g chopped tomatoes
- salt to taste

## Instructions

1. Warm the oil and soften the onion.
2. Add garlic, beans and tomatoes.
3. Simmer for 1 hour and season.
